title: Orinstonechat
description: This plugin is for chat, allowing users to speak in the chat using colors.
body:
OrinstoneChat is a lightweight, efficient, and highly customizable chat management solution designed to enhance your server's communication experience. Built with performance in mind, version 1.0.0 provides server administrators with a solid foundation for managing real-time chat, keeping it clean, organized, and user-friendly.

Whether you are running a small private server for friends or a growing public community, OrinstoneChat delivers a seamless, lag-free chat experience.

✨ Features
Lightweight & Optimized: Designed to have a minimal footprint, ensuring maximum server performance without chat lag.

Modern Formatting: Clean and intuitive chat layout that improves readability for all players.

Easy Configuration: Simple setup out of the box, allowing you to tailor the chat experience to your server's needs.

Robust Foundation: Version 1.0.0 establishes a stable environment built for reliability and future feature expansions.
